```{r}
# Every dataset value comes from the profile P (config.R; plan section 4).
col_shoe <- P$col_shoe # the number of columns in each shoe
row_shoe <- P$row_shoe # the number of rows in each shoe
num_shoe <- P$num_shoe  # the number of shoes (OLD: 386 of them have RACs - shoe 127 has no RACS)

rel_col_shoe <- P$coords$rel_col_shoe  # the relevant columns (contain non zero pixels in some shoes)
rel_row_shoe <- P$coords$rel_row_shoe  # the relevant rows (contain non zero pixels in some shoes)
rel_x_cord <- P$coords$rel_x_cord # using coordinates as in the locations file the relevant x coordinates are between -rel_x_cord and rel_x_cord
rel_Y_cord <- P$coords$rel_Y_cord # the relevant Y coordinates are between -rel_Y_cord and rel_Y_cord

# The prototype (map) frame: the OLD prototype grid for both datasets (A-001, A-006)
col_proto <- P$prototype$col_shoe
row_proto <- P$prototype$row_shoe
proto_rel_col_shoe <- P$prototype$coords$rel_col_shoe
proto_rel_Y_cord <- P$prototype$coords$rel_Y_cord

file_name <- rac_path(P, "dataCC")
dataCC <- read.csv(file_name, header = TRUE)

```


```{r contour_distance_}

#get convex hull contours as a list of doubles(row_shoe*col_shoe) of pixel and convert them to x-y  coordinates
#record i is the i-th analysis shoe = shoe code i of dataCC (A-031, A-053); the file must hold exactly these records
file_name <- rac_path(P, "contour")
n_records <- length(rac_analysis_shoes(P))
if (file.size(file_name) != (col_shoe * row_shoe + 2) * n_records) {
  stop(file_name, " is not ", n_records, " records of ", col_shoe, " x ", row_shoe, " + 2 bytes")
}
d <- readChar(file_name, nchars = (col_shoe * row_shoe + 2) * n_records) 
contour_txt <- list() 
for (i in seq_len(n_records)) {
  contour_txt[[i]] <- matrix(
    as.numeric(unlist(strsplit(substr(d, 1 + (col_shoe * row_shoe + 2) * (i - 1), (col_shoe * row_shoe + 2) * i - 2), split = ""))),
    row_shoe, col_shoe, byrow = 1
  )
}
#now get the x,y coordinates
contour_pix <- list() 
# each data_pix[[i]] is a matrix with column 1 indicating the shoe, 2 the x, 3 the y, 4 the amount of RACs in that pixel
# we include only data where there is contact surface (after adjusting for the case that if there is a RAC there will be contact surface)
for (i in seq_len(n_records)) {
  xcoor <- t(matrix(rep((-col_shoe / 2 + 1:col_shoe) * rel_Y_cord / rel_col_shoe, row_shoe), col_shoe, row_shoe))
  ycoor <- -matrix(rep((-row_shoe / 2 + 1:row_shoe) * rel_Y_cord / rel_col_shoe, col_shoe), row_shoe, col_shoe)
  shoe <- rep(i, length(contour_txt[[i]][contour_txt[[i]] == 1]))
  contour_pix[[i]] <- cbind(shoe, xcoor[contour_txt[[i]] == 1], ycoor[contour_txt[[i]] == 1]) # the data is only where there is contact surface
}
contour_pix_use <- numeric()
for (i in seq_len(n_records)) {
  contour_pix_use <- rbind(contour_pix_use, contour_pix[[i]]) 
}

# at this stade, in convex_pix_use we have for each shoe, each point of the contour
```

```{r contour_distance_6}
#now for each row of dataCC we have to calculate the distance within each point of convex_pix_use
#convex_pix_use[,5]
calculate_distance <- function(x1, y1, x2, y2) {
  sqrt((x1 - x2)^2 + (y1 - y2)^2)
}

calculate_min_distance <- function(new_data, contour_alg_df) {
  new_data$row_number <- seq_len(nrow(new_data))
  for (i in 1:nrow(new_data)) {
    percentage <- round(100 * i / nrow(new_data), 3)
    if (i %% 1000 == 0) {
      message("row N.", i, ": ", percentage, "%\n")
    }
    min_distance <- Inf
    distance <- Inf
    contour_df2 <- contour_alg_df[contour_alg_df$shoe == new_data$shoe[i], ]
    for (j in 1:nrow(contour_df2)) {
      distance <- calculate_distance(new_data$x[i], new_data$y[i], contour_df2$x[j], contour_df2$y[j])
      if (distance < min_distance) {
        min_distance <- distance
      }
    }
    new_data$min_dist[i] <- min_distance
  }
rac_write_csv(new_data, P, "dataCC_distance_temp")
  return(new_data)
}


## MIN HORIZONTALLY DISTANCE

calculate_min_horiz_distance <- function(new_data, contour_alg_df){
  
  for (i in 1:nrow(new_data)) {
    percentage <- round(100 * i / nrow(new_data),3)
    if (i %% 1000 == 0) {
        message("row N.", i, ": ", percentage, "%\n")
    }
    min_horiz_dist <- Inf
    contour_df2 <- contour_alg_df[contour_alg_df$shoe==new_data$shoe[i],]
    for (j in 1:nrow(contour_df2)) {
      if (abs(new_data$y[i] - contour_df2$y[j]) <0.01){
        distance <- calculate_distance(new_data$x[i], new_data$y[i],contour_df2$x[j],  contour_df2$y[j])
        if (distance < min_horiz_dist) {
          min_horiz_dist <- distance
        }
      }
    }
    new_data$horiz_dist[i] <- min_horiz_dist
  }
  new_data$horiz_dist[is.infinite(new_data$horiz_dist)] <- new_data$min_dist[is.infinite(new_data$horiz_dist)]
  rac_write_csv(new_data, P, "dataCC_distance_temp")
  return(new_data)
}

```

```{r DIST TO BINARY CATEGORY}
# HORIZ DISTANCE
#horiz_dist_mean <- mean(new_data$horiz_dist)
file_name <- rac_path(P, "dataCC_distance_temp")
```

```{r }

# The prototype contour in its own frame (P$prototype), never in the data frame of the dataset
image <- t(as.matrix(load.image(rac_path(P, "prototype_contour"))))
stopifnot(all(dim(image) == c(row_proto, col_proto)))
xcoor <- t(matrix(rep((-col_proto / 2 + 1:col_proto) * proto_rel_Y_cord / proto_rel_col_shoe, row_proto), col_proto, row_proto))
ycoor <- -matrix(rep((-row_proto / 2 + 1:row_proto) * proto_rel_Y_cord / proto_rel_col_shoe, col_proto), row_proto, col_proto)
entire_contour <- data.frame(x = xcoor[image == 1], y = ycoor[image == 1]) # the data 
distance_per_y <- entire_contour %>% group_by(y) %>% summarise(min_x = abs(min(x)), max_x = max(x))

dist_shape = c()
for (i in 1:nrow(new_data)) {
  y_val = new_data$y[i]
  if (new_data$x[i] <= 0) {
    new_val <- distance_per_y[(distance_per_y$y >= y_val - 0.01) & (distance_per_y$y <= y_val + 0.01), c("y", "min_x")]
    if (nrow(new_val) > 0) {
      closest_row_index <- which.min(abs(new_val$y - y_val))
      closest_value <- new_val[closest_row_index, ]$min_x
    } else {
      # If no match found, use the closest y value from distance_per_y
      closest_y_index <- which.min(abs(distance_per_y$y - y_val))
      closest_value <- abs(distance_per_y[closest_y_index, ]$min_x)
    }
  } else {
    new_val <- distance_per_y[(distance_per_y$y >= y_val - 0.01) & (distance_per_y$y <= y_val + 0.01), c("y", "max_x")]
    if (nrow(new_val) > 0) {
      closest_row_index <- which.min(abs(new_val$y - y_val))
      closest_value <- new_val[closest_row_index, ]$max_x
    } else {
      # If no match found, use the closest y value from distance_per_y
      closest_y_index <- which.min(abs(distance_per_y$y - y_val))
      closest_value <- distance_per_y[closest_y_index, ]$max_x
    }
  }
  #cat(i, '\t', y_val, '\t', closest_value, '\n')
  dist_shape <- append(dist_shape, closest_value)
}
new_data$distance_shape <- dist_shape

new_data$new_x <- (new_data$x * new_data$distance_shape) / (abs(new_data$x) + new_data$horiz_dist)
rac_write_csv(new_data, P, "dataCC_distance")
```
